explication:
## Purpose and entry points
Codex Taskboard is a local-first task/project board usable in a browser, through a macOS launcher that embeds it into Codex/ChatGPT, and through automation clients. Primary entry points are the Node HTTP service (`server/index.mjs`), React client (`web/src/main.tsx`), CLI (`cli/taskctl.mjs`), and Tauri launcher (`src-tauri/src/main.rs`).

## Local service and persistence
The Node service owns the HTTP API, SQLite-backed task data, attachments, and real-time synchronization. It serves the built web client, writes local data under the configured data directory, and uses server-sent events to notify connected boards; reconnecting clients perform a full refresh.
- `server/app.mjs`
- `server/database.mjs`
- `server/index.mjs`

## Domain and workflow model
Shared modules define taskboard domain concepts plus workflow sequencing/control-flow semantics used across service, UI, CLI, and automation. Project automation policies bridge task state changes to Codex-oriented execution behavior.
- `shared/domain.mjs`
- `shared/workflow-control-flow.mjs`
- `shared/taskboard-automation.mjs`

## React taskboard client
The Vite/React application consumes the local API and presents dashboard, board, Gantt/list, issue detail/editor, relations, comments, attachments, and project automation configuration. Client state includes storage-backed preferences, API access, revision polling, and AI-chat state.
- `web/src/App.tsx`
- `web/src/api.ts`
- `web/src/components/TaskDetail.tsx`

## AI chat subsystem
The server exposes AI-chat endpoints and coordinates process execution, turn ownership, cataloging, and persisted chat/task state. The web UI renders the corresponding conversation experience, keeping this integration behind the HTTP API rather than directly invoking local Codex capabilities.
- `server/ai-chat.mjs`
- `server/ai-chat-process.mjs`
- `web/src/components/AiChat.tsx`

## Codex/ChatGPT embedding and automation
Injection tooling launches or attaches to a Chromium DevTools Protocol-enabled official client, bypasses renderer CSP as needed, and inserts the taskboard entry/iframe without modifying the vendor application. Shared executable/environment discovery and the supervisor support long-running injected sessions and recovery.
- `scripts/codex-injector.mjs`
- `scripts/taskboard-supervisor.mjs`
- `inject/codex-taskboard.user.js`

## macOS distribution runtime
A Tauri Rust launcher packages Node, server, web assets, CLI, injector, and skill into a universal macOS app. It starts a loopback service on a random port, starts a separate official-client window with a random CDP port, injects the board, supervises failures, and uses Tauri’s signed updater. GitHub Actions builds, signs, notarizes, verifies, and promotes immutable releases.
- `src-tauri/src/main.rs`
- `src-tauri/tauri.conf.json`
- `.github/workflows/release-macos.yml`

## Optional cloud collaboration
Cloud deployment is a Cloudflare Worker-based shared backend using D1 migrations, static assets, and private R2 attachments. Local devices retain project checkout mappings and companion capabilities; cloud proxy/config code separates this optional synchronized mode from the local database runtime.
- `cloud/src/index.mjs`
- `cloud/migrations/0001_initial.sql`
- `server/cloud-proxy.mjs`
